data.narrative:
Cosmic Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by James Emerick and Lewis Jones that has raised $4.5M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using the $4.5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement. This method implies a valuation of $11.3M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable; while ten same-sector peers exist in the Robotics & Manufacturing universe, the narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier) yielded insufficient datapoints—fewer than the three required for reliable comparison—making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $9.6M (low) to $12.9M (high), with a median of $11.3M. This single-method triangulation reflects limited data density at the Seed stage within this sector. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient narrow-stage peer data and reliance on a stage-progression multiplier that may not fully capture Cosmic Robotics' specific risk profile, market traction, or technology differentiation. Additional diligence on revenue, customer pipeline, and technical maturity would strengthen conviction in this range.
